claim: Computers routinely reach an ever-available high-bandwidth network.
originalWording: Computers routinely reach an ever-available high-bandwidth network.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Computer Itself, prediction 13, printed p. 21

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Wireless Internet is a routine built-in capability with useful broadband availability in connected markets.
reference.rationale: Pew found 56% of US adults had used wireless Internet by 2009; shipping devices included Wi-Fi/cellular connectivity. Routine access is established. Universal coverage, perfect uptime and unlimited bandwidth were not imposed as extra requirements.

evidence.title: Wireless Internet Use — Pew Research Center
evidence.note: Wireless Internet Use overview: opening wireless-use finding and mobile-use comparison bullets. Pew reports 56% of Americans had ever used wireless Internet and 19% used mobile Internet the previous day in its April 2009 survey. Evidence limits: These are US adult survey measures, not global population coverage, wireless traffic share or a continuous-service guarantee.

evidence.title: iPhone App Store downloads top 10 million
evidence.note: Paragraph describing cellular-network and Wi-Fi access to the App Store. The release confirms operational wireless software delivery on shipping mobile platforms. Evidence limits: It does not measure continuous coverage, throughput or population-wide usage.

evidence.title: Apple reinvents the phone with iPhone
evidence.note: Data-networking paragraph and Breakthrough Internet Communications Device section. Apple describes EDGE and Wi-Fi web/email access on the announced 2007 iPhone. Evidence limits: This documents product capability, not reliable universal coverage or usage prevalence.

strict.criterion: The network is instantly available with high bandwidth across essentially all ordinary locations.
strict.rationale: Coverage and reliability qualifications remain. This gives additional weight to the “ever-present” language without treating an isolated outage as failure.
